gbp_allocation_guard_v1.reason: Three consecutive net losses in the same GBP policy, across all wallets and tokens
gbp_allocation_guard_v1.resume_policy: No timed reset. Requires separately reviewed prospective evidence and explicit versioned release; never erase the suspension.

historical_audit.interpretation: Descriptive only. Legacy winners are non-comparable across changed exits.

gbp_signal_lab_v1.warning: Signal-time registered quote comparison only, no actual fills; historical pattern mining cannot validate this strategy. 100+ prospective independent trades across >=14 dates, closed net economics, cost stress and clustered holdout are required before separate review; no automatic promotion.

gbp_quote_ta_v1.evidence_note: Polled spot quotes, NOT OHLC candles or executable fills. Fixed indicator hypotheses, 1% per-side cost + 2pp stress, distinct pool/day caution. No actual trades, risk gate changes, or automatic strategy promotion.

candidate_rules.tempered_continuation: liquidity>=100k, age>=6h, m5 -0.5..1%, h1 1..10%, volume pace 0.4..1.2, buyers 45..58%
candidate_rules.mature_liquid_pullback: liquidity>=250k, age>=24h, m5 -3..0%, h1 0..12%, volume pace 0.2..1.2, buyers 40..58%
candidate_rules.policy_low_chase: original gate plus liquidity>=100k, age>=6h, m5 -1..1%, h1 0..12%, volume pace 0.2..1.2, buyers 40..58%

gbp_holdout_lab_v1.evidence_note: Separate post-registration holdout; quote returns are not fills. Review requires 100 priced outcomes across 14 days/30 pools, majority wins, positive extra-stressed net result, profit factor above one, positive result without the best observation/day/pool and improvement over the fixed all-signal control. No automatic GBP resumption.
